name: Presentation Layer
description: Streamlit UI rendering, i18n strings, CSS styling, page layout, and the five-step wizard state machine that drives the user-facing conversation flow.

name: Prompt Engineering Layer
description: LLM prompt templates for the six conversation modes: system persona, requirement clarification, PRD generation, section refinement, competitive analysis, and quality evaluation.

name: Domain Model Layer
description: PRD domain structures: six product-type templates with industry-specific focus areas, the 7+1 module section definitions, and AI product keyword detection logic.

name: Infrastructure Layer
description: LLM client management (OpenAI SDK, multi-source config resolution, streaming), multi-provider definitions (DeepSeek/OpenAI/Claude/Zhipu/Qwen/Doubao/Custom), web search via DuckDuckGo with function-calling tool schema, and Markdown/DOCX export converters.

name: Utility Scripts
description: Standalone build script for generating the PRD Copilot product specification as a styled Word document, independent of the main Streamlit application.

name: Configuration Layer
description: Environment variable templates for API keys and model selection, and Python dependency declarations.

name: Documentation Layer
description: Project README, design decision records, product specification documents (Markdown and Word), and research references on prompt engineering and architecture patterns.
